summary: Johnny Gaines, a Leadville local, was killed in a snowmobile crash near Turquoise Lake on Sunday afternoon; he collided with a tree at a crash site accessible only by foot or snow machine. The Lake County Sheriff's Office responded within minutes of a 911 call and emergency medical services arrived quickly, but Gaines was pronounced dead on-scene.
responding_agency: Lake County Sheriff's Office; Lake County EMS
notes: Coroner identified the deceased as Johnny Gaines. No SAR-team response documented in the Herald account — excluded-from-SAR-convention not applied: documented backcountry fatality with public reporting; first indexed Lake County 2023 row.
